ARCS kitMolecule 36change

Change

Show how far a belief moved and which way, readable at a glance and without colour.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1Signed pointsMono, display size, bold: the headline of the changefs-display · green / red / muted
2Before and afterMono, label size: the states behind the changefs-label · text-secondary
3TrackThe 0 to 100 scale the change sits onborder
4Tail tickWhere the belief startedtext-secondary
5ArrowSegment and filled head at the end value; the head points the way it moveddirection colour

Usage

Use it when

  • A belief, a score or a confidence moved between two moments and the reader needs the size and direction first.
  • The before and after values are on one 0 to 100 scale.

Do not use it when

  • The two values are on different scales or units; show them side by side instead.
  • The value did not move in a way that matters; say so in the sentence and skip the molecule.
  • You only have colour to offer: this molecule always carries the sign and the arrow.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
beforenumber 0 to 1yesConfidence at the start.
afternumber 0 to 1yesConfidence at the end. Points are rounded to whole numbers before the sign is taken.

Access

  • The whole molecule has an aria-label such as +40 pts, 40% to 80%; the arrow is hidden from screen readers.
  • Direction reads three ways: the sign, the arrow head and the colour. Remove any one and it still reads.
  • Numbers use tabular figures so stacked changes line up.
  • Not interactive on its own; when it sits inside a button the button carries focus.
